{{Quote|The Aii`tkian Anthropologists in Area D-502 have found a new strain of copper thanks to the O.S.S. "Junk Dealers" Guild. The scientists believe the new copper will be used effectively for starship shields and various parts.|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|Imperial Daily News}}</ref>}}
The '''O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild''', also known as the '''"Junk X'press" Guild''', was a group of [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealers]] active in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild operated in the Dantooine system. They were based in the [[Area D-502]]<ref name="SWG:AD502" /> but were also present in the [[Wall of Dantooine]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] and near the destroyed [[Legacy YT Indigo Blue]] station.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66853&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Dantooine System}}</ref> Due to the lack of protection provided by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the O.S.S. D-502 junk dealers had allied with a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], the [[Aii`tkian Anthropologists]], to protect themselves against the [[Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild]].<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

In space, Junk X'press" Guild pilots flew [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]] and [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:DS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Dantooine system}}</ref>

==History==
Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the O.S.S. Junk Guild and the Aii`tkian Anthropologists discovered a new strain of [[Copper/Legends|copper]] in the Dantooine system's Area D-502. Aii`tkian scientists then investigated whether it was worth to be used to manufacture [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts.<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />
